scripts.electron:build: npx esbuild src/electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs --format=cjs --external:electron && npx esbuild src/electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs --format=cjs --external:electron
scripts.verify:build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p src/electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build && npm run electron:build && node -e "console.log('READER_BUILD_VERIFIED')"
